_comment: The OpenNova editor demo's storyboard (scripts/demo/README.md): the scenes in cut order, each with its caption and the marks its frames are cut between, the takes that record them, and the GIF's ranges. A cut piece runs from one mark to another ('label', or 'label+N' / 'label-N' frames), sped up to 'seconds' when given, its last frame held 'hold' seconds; a 'still' piece shows a PNG of the take for 'seconds'. 'shows' and 'mcp' document the scene as recorded. Captions take no em dashes.
title: OpenNova editor demo
